info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Servicing Order Management API
info.description: The Servicing Order Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage servicing orders efficiently. Through this API, users can streamline order creation for various banking services, enhancing operational workflow. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and backend systems handling servicing requests. This API supports seamless interactions by allowing the submission of servicing orders, ensuring timely processing and improved customer satisfaction.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new servicing order in the system. It requires the necessary details to be provided in the request body and will return the created order information upon success.
